iso_4217.source: Unicode ICU 77.1 / CLDR 47 currency list as exposed by Intl.supportedValuesOf('currency') in Node.js 24.10.0. This is ICU's list of ISO 4217 codes, not the ISO 4217 maintenance agency's own table: it keeps some withdrawn codes (for example HRK, SLL, ZWL) and the X-codes (XAF, XDR ...).
